candidates.observation: Generic condition boilerplate containing VHS/DVD triggered non_game_product despite target-game box, cartridge, and manual being visible.
candidates.proposedLearning: Classify description spans as product-specific versus marketplace boilerplate before applying reject tokens; require a product-specific conflict or visual conflict for non-game rejection.

candidates.observation: High-detail classification found box, cartridge, and manual in one image, but the normalized observation collapsed to UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.
candidates.proposedLearning: Preserve one component-bound observation per confidently classified component even when multiple components share an image.

candidates.observation: Exact EAN/MPN values existed in the frozen Browse API payload but did not reach the Engine bundle, causing generic-title searches.
candidates.proposedLearning: Pass normalized API EAN/UPC/MPN into the Knowledge Pack as explicitly low-trust LISTING_METADATA identifiers and immediately route exact verification without promoting them to physical evidence.

candidates.observation: The Engine captured all decisive component-bound evidence but did not map it to existing Japan/USA sibling entries.
candidates.proposedLearning: Expose all same-work regional siblings in catalog alternatives and add deterministic market-text rules for explicit Japan-only legal text and distributor-bound USA box evidence.

candidates.observation: External sources can solve product-family identifiers but cannot manufacture listing-bound condition, seal, disc, or package evidence absent from the selected listing.
candidates.proposedLearning: After exact product-family mapping, stop and DEFER when the remaining gap is specimen-bound and the original listing has no eligible component photo.
